❯ Write a 1500-word short story about a lighthouse
  keeper, directly in your reply.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ⏵⏵ auto mode on (shift+tab to cycle)
  visit twice a year. Mr. Mott's service was greatly
  appreciated. A cottage in Carrow could be made
  available to him at a reduced rent.

  He read it twice at the kitchen table, folded it along
  its creases, and put it in the drawer with the tide
  tables. Then he went up the hundred and twelve steps
  and wound the clockwork, though it hadn't needed
  winding since 1994, when they fitted the electric
  motor. His hands wanted something to do.

  That night at ten the kitchen window flashed twice. He
  answered twice. He wondered, for the first time in
  years, whether whoever was over there knew.

  ---

  The technician arrived on the last Tuesday of August.
